title: The Burnt Safehouse
author: Juniper Ishikawa
blurb: Ines Crane, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
